en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a seaside promenade lined with palm trees and formal gardens. On the left stands an ornate pavilion on a pier extending into the sea, while people stroll along the broad waterfront boulevard. Elegant multi‑story buildings and a monument with a statue or obelisk are visible on the right, with hills in the background. The printed caption identifies the scene as the Jetty-Palace and the English Walk in Nice.
